g.text: One representative worker pair. Arrows show the forward path.
Inner: 10.244.x.y Pod IPs. Outer: 100.x node IPs. MTU: 1230 + 50 = 1280.
No VXLAN or Tailscale hop for two Pods on the same worker.
NodePort: tailnet client → 100.x:NodePort on tailscale0 → eBPF backend lookup.
Never advertise 10.244.0.0/16 or 10.96.0.0/12 as Tailscale subnet routes.
Cilium owns Pod / Service routing; Tailscale carries the node underlay.
